project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, cloud white, product-specific brand colors

main_subject.detail: A 2 by 2 grid of small branded helicopters suspended in a bright blue sky, each carrying a giant matching branded product beneath it.
main_subject.style: Hyper-real playful CGI-advertising with clean sky photography

composition_elements.text: Once You Pop, You Can’t Stop.; More Fanta. Less Serious.; STAY PLAYFUL; Accelerating the Future
items: Upper left: red Pringles helicopter carrying a can.
Upper right: orange Fanta helicopter carrying a soda can.
Lower left: Oreo helicopter carrying a blue pack.
Lower right: Tesla helicopter carrying a Cybertruck.
All cells: blue sky, scattered soft clouds, brand logo and slogan at bottom.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp clear sky, subtle lens flare, soft cloud bounce, clear underslung product visibility

assets.name: brand product
assets.usage: Preserve the carried product identity, label, and proportions.

assets.name: official brand logo
assets.usage: Place accurate mark and approved slogan at lower edge.

prompt_instructions: Attach approved logo, product packaging, and slogan assets.
Use a fictional or generic helicopter structure; map only the brand color and graphic language.
Keep the product visibly connected by a sling beneath the helicopter.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic, square 1:1 image featuring a small helicopter flying through a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a subtle lens flare. The helicopter is painted in the signature colors and graphics of [BRAND]. It is carrying a giant product from [BRAND] hanging below. The composition has the look and feel of a clean, playful (or premium, futuristic) advertisement. At the bottom, include the [BRAND] logo and a small slogan like [BRAND SLOGAN] in a stylish font. 1080x1080 dimension.
prompt.negative_prompt: unbranded product, incorrect logo, disconnected sling, dark storm, crowded composition, warped helicopter, unreadable slogan, watermark
